about_the_game:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~【Invitation】~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Dear high witchness,

The Lanternville is glad to inform you that the next Magic Lantern Festival will soon be held.

Everything you need to participate is thirst for wisdom and a nice little familiar.

Under the name of The Great Witch, let us praise every single drop of knowledge!

Sincerely yours,
Magic Lantern Festival Committee

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~


To newborn witches, the Magic Lantern Festival is a feast held in Lanternville every time the committee feels motivated.
This time, the rule is very simple; let your familiar survive a bullet hell of magic for a certain period of time.

Each witch you encounter in Lanternville will continuously emit magic while giving random quizzes on their field of specialty.
Not answering or making mistakes on the given quiz will result in tough penalty... Don't think about doing so on purpose!



-----------------------------------------------------------------------

On a pixel-designed 2D stage, you will have to survive a bullet hell for a certain time period.
Not only that... you also need to answer quizzes simultaneously in order not to let the bullet hell become more and more dense.

During the Early Access, players can access to 9 genres of quizzes, each of them with an Easy mode and Hard mode.
There is also a practice mode where you can only practice solving the quizzes (without the bullet hell).

name: Magic Lantern Festival

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: *Keyboard needs to contain arrow keys
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: 4-core intel or AMD, 3.0GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: *Keyboard needs to contain arrow keys

short_description: Magic Lantern Festival is a hyper multitask 2D bullet hell. Players are required to recreate their brain in order to dodge all the magic bullets and answer random quizzes simultaneously.
